en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aape aap varatadhaa piaaraa aape aap apaahu ||

en.bdb: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

verse.unicode: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: vanajaaraa jag aap hai piaaraa aape saachaa saahu ||

en.bdb: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: aape vanaj vaapaareeaa piaaraa aape sach vesaahu ||1||

en.bdb: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ ॥

transliteration.english: jap man har har naam salaeh ||

en.bdb: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: gur kirapaa te paieeaai piaaraa a(n)mrit agam athaeh || rahaau ||

en.bdb: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord is obtained. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aape sun sabh vekhadhaa piaaraa mukh bole aap muhaahu ||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through the mouths of all beings.

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aape ujhaR paidhaa piaaraa aap vikhaale raahu ||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape veparavaahu ||2||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aape aap upaidhaa piaaraa sir aape dha(n)dhaRai laahu ||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.

verse.unicode: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aap karaae saakhatee piaaraa aap maare mar jaahu ||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਣੁ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: aape patan paatanee piaaraa aape paar la(n)ghaahu ||3||

en.bdb: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aape saagar bohithaa piaaraa gur khevaT aap chalaahu ||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatman who steers it

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aape hee chaR la(n)ghadhaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai paatisaahu ||

en.bdb: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrous play.

verse.unicode: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੧॥

transliteration.english: aape aap dhiaal hai piaaraa jan naanak bakhas milaahu ||4||1||

en.bdb: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blends with Himself. ||4||1||
